name: EverGreen Treated Wood (DBA Iowa Wood Preservers)
old_description: We offer a diverse line of treatment products that allow us to treat and manufacture lumber products for various uses and applications.
about:
EverGreen Treated Wood, doing business as Iowa Wood Preservers, operates from its headquarters in Oskaloosa, Iowa, with additional facilities in Sutton, Nebraska, and Willmar, Minnesota. The company is family-owned and was founded by Vic Sowl, who remains listed as founder; his son Nick Sowl serves as president. The business began as a wholesale supplier of pressure-treated lumber and has expanded to three Midwestern locations serving regional markets.

The company pressure-treats and manufactures a range of lumber products for structural and specialty applications. Its treatment lines include CCA for commercial, industrial, and agricultural uses; MCA-based Lifewood Residential for exterior exposure; and Pyro-Guard fire-retardant lumber and plywood for enclosed structural applications. Value-added services include kiln drying after treatment (KDAT) to improve stability and allow immediate finishing, precision end trimming to uniform lengths, notched runner fabrication for shed foundations, and V-groove paneling for interior wall and ceiling use. The three plants are managed by a leadership team of roughly 15 named managers spanning sales, plant operations, and finance.

EverGreen serves agricultural, residential, government and utility, marine, and wood-foundation construction markets. Agricultural customers use treated posts and framing for barns, livestock buildings, and utility sheds. Residential buyers specify Lifewood for decks, framing, and guardrails. Government and utility projects call for fire-retardant and marine-grade plywood, while wood-foundation systems rely on pressure-treated lumber for below-grade durability.

The company states its focus is on delivering durable, cost-effective treated lumber across the Midwest, backed by a commitment to wood-preservation quality and customer service. UL listing is cited as a mark of compliance for its treated products.
